name: Necromancer Crown's Call raises Intellect and puts its Frost damage aura on raised minions (#1075)
contract: Crown's Call is a Necromancer Rime talent with two ranks (CharacterAdvancement 30617, ClassType 25 = class 23, Tab 60 Rime, TalentEssenceCost 1: 805429, 807924). Its client description reads 'Increases your Intellect by $s2% and the Frost damage dealt by your Undead minions by $s1%.' Effect 1 is SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA with SPELL_AURA_MOD_TOTAL_STAT_PERCENTAGE (137), MiscValue 3 (Intellect), BasePoints 4 / 9 + DieSides 1 = 5% / 10%. Effect 0 is SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_APPLY_AURA_TO_SUMMONS (190) with SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE (79), MiscValue 16 (Frost), BasePoints 9 / 19 + 1 = 10% / 20%, radius 100 yd; UnitAura::FillTargetMap gives that effect to the owner's live, owned summons only, never to the Necromancer. No Necromancer contract rewrites these effects. Player::UpdateStats stores whole Intellect points, so with at least 100 Intellect the truncated ratio stays within 1.04-1.051 for 5% and 1.09-1.101 for 10% (level-80 Undead Necromancer: 166 class Intellect - 2 racial). Learning rank 1 must raise Intellect by 5% and put the Necromancer's Crown's Call aura on a raised Ghoul (entry 50073); unlearning removes both; rank 2 raises Intellect by 10% and its aura reaches the Ghoul. The harness cannot read a non-pet minion's aura amount or execute its Frost damage, so the minion side checks the caster-owned aura on the Ghoul, not the 10% / 20% magnitude.

steps.label: Let login and stat updates settle
CONTROL: the Ghoul carries no Crown's Call aura yet
DISCRIMINATING: rank 1's Frost damage aura reaches the Ghoul
Unlearning removes the aura from the Ghoul
Rank 2's Frost damage aura reaches the Ghoul
